app.name: Code Graph
app.description: Multi-language code analysis system based on tree-sitter

args.init: Initialize database and build full graph
args.force: Force reparse all files (ignore incremental build)
args.topo_limit: Number of topo sorted items to show
args.file: Get all symbols in a file
args.history: View all historical versions of a function
args.restore_all_comments: Batch restore comments for all functions with history
args.restore_file: Only restore comments for specified file (with --restore-all-comments)
args.preview: Preview restore result (don't write to file)
args.uncommented: List uncommented symbols (default: fn, optional: struct/enum/trait)
args.uncommented_module: Module filter for uncommented symbols (prefix match)
args.search_kind: Filter search results by symbol kind
args.impact: Impact analysis: trace upstream functions that call this function
args.call_chain: Call chain down: trace downstream functions called by this function
args.orphan_symbols: Uncalled orphan symbols (default: fn, optional: struct/enum/trait)
args.orphan_module: Module filter for orphan symbols (prefix match)
args.deepest: Deepest call depth functions ranking (default: top 20)
args.export_module_graph: Export module dependency graph (mermaid or dot, default: mermaid)
args.graph_output: Output file path for module graph
args.call_heatmap: Function call frequency heatmap (module or file, default: module)
args.function_issues: Detect function issues (missing comments/hardcoded/TODO/unwrap/etc.), optionally specify function name
args.semgrep_save: Save Semgrep scan results to database
args.issue_module: Module filter for issue detection (prefix match)
args.semgrep_config: Semgrep ruleset config (default: p/default, e.g. p/security, p/best-practices)
